skill.summary: Generate videos using Flyworks (a.k.a HiFly) Digital Humans. Create talking photo videos from images, use public avatars with TTS, or clone voices for custom audio.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of flyworks-avatar-video skill.
- Generate videos using Flyworks/HiFly Digital Humans: talking photos, public avatars with TTS, or cloned voices.
- Includes command-line tool for listing avatars/voices, creating videos, talking photo videos, and voice cloning.
- Supports workflow with free-tier token (with watermark and 30s video limit); instructions provided for setting up custom API keys.
- Provides agent guidelines for interactive user support and memory management of avatars/voices.
